name: NetLines
srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — preview parameterization. The record's `NetLines` defaults `velocity`, `partialDiffs`, `loading` and adds loading/error states, so it renders standalone in a preview that mounts records with no props; the file's takes them as required props from its caller. Region-scoped check: the file's `NetLines` holds 1 substantive line(s) the record lacks — under the 8-line threshold at which parameterization stops being a full explanation, so it is treated as explained. NOT zero, though: if this component ever gained behaviour the record missed, those 1 line(s) are where to look. Refreshing from the file would discard the parameterization. Written by scripts/reconcile-record-src.cjs --annotate.
whenNot: Commit/PR counts over time — use Velocity.
